server_host.description: IP address the server listens on (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or a specific public IP)

server_port.description: Port number the server listens on for incoming client connections

local_host.description: Local address the shadowsocks client/proxy listens on (for local SOCKS5 or transparent proxy)

local_port.description: Local port for SOCKS5 proxy (used when shadowsocks runs as a client or transparent proxy)

method.description: Encryption cipher (e.g., aes-256-gcm, chacha20-ietf-poly1305). Prefer AEAD ciphers for security & performance

password.description: Shared secret password for encryption and authentication (must match client config)

timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. Increase for slow networks or large file transfers

dns_server.description: Optional DNS server (e.g., 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1) for DNS resolution via shadowsocks. Leave blank for system default

udp_enabled.description: Enable UDP relay support (required for DNS over UDP, gaming, WebRTC)

no_log.description: If true, disables logging entirely (useful for privacy-sensitive deployments)

fast_open.description: Enable TCP Fast Open (reduces latency; requires Linux kernel ≥ 3.7.1 and sysctl tcp_fastopen)

acl.description: Path to ACL file (e.g., /etc/shadowsocks-libev/acl.json) to restrict allowed domains or IPs

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit size. Adjust if packet fragmentation is observed (e.g., 1300–1450)

mptcp.description: Enable Multipath TCP (requires kernel & network support). Not recommended for general use

ipv6_first.description: Prefer IPv6 addresses over IPv4 when resolving DNS (for dual-stack networks)

plugins.description: Optional list of obfuscation plugins. Currently supports only one plugin; specify as single-item list

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn (requires --workers flag at runtime; useful for multi-core systems)

log_file.description: Path to log file (e.g., /var/log/shadowsocks-libev.log). Leave blank to log to stderr only
